# Titles (applications, applets, system / shared data, TWL) - auto-generated by tools/make_titles_doc.py

Everything under `o3ds/extracted` / `o3ds/updates` and `n3ds/updates` that is not a sysmodule or FIRM was decrypted and unpacked with `tools/extract_titles.py`
(`o3ds/decrypted_titles/`, `n3ds/decrypted_titles/`: per title `code.bin`, `exheader.bin`, `exefs_dir/`, full `romfs/` tree, `analysis/`).
Each code image was analysed by `tools/title_analysis.py` (radare2 function list, SVC wrappers, IPC candidates, service strings, pointer tables, **C++ RTTI recovery**,
source-path attribution, string-referencing functions) and cross-named by `tools/library_propagation.py` (masked-byte identity with functions named in any other binary, either model).

Symbol rows: `n3ds/symbols/titles/TITLES_SYMBOL_TABLE.csv` and `o3ds/symbols_titles/TITLES_SYMBOL_TABLE.csv`; per-title inventory: `TITLES_INVENTORY.csv` next to them; all cross-binary matches: `n3ds/symbols/titles/LIBRARY_MATCHES.csv`.

Confidence levels of these rows: `derived_rtti` (class names read from the binary's own RTTI strings; virtual-slot / vptr-init names add only the index/address), `derived_source_ref` (function references a source path string), `derived_string_ref`, `derived_structural` (SVC wrapper, IPC, service strings, pointer tables), `library_match` (masked bytes identical to a named function elsewhere).
